summary: Russia launched a massive coordinated drone and missile barrage targeting Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian oblasts throughout September 27, with Geran-5 ballistic missiles and reactive Shahed drones striking the capital, residential areas, markets, and energy infrastructure. Russian forces simultaneously established control over Kripuny in Kharkiv Oblast and struck the Kyivstar data processing center in Kyiv. Ukrainian forces reported significant gains on the Liman direction in Donetsk under Operation Vivaldi, eliminating 10,660 Russian personnel in one week.
key_points: Russia struck Kyiv with reactive drones and Geran-5 missiles throughout September 27, hitting residential buildings, schools, kindergartens, the Stolichnyi market, and the Kyivstar data center, causing casualties and fires (Source: @UkraineNow/84351).
Russian forces reportedly established control over Kripuny in Kharkiv Oblast and began ODKB exercises, while also striking the Kyivstar data processing center in Kyiv (Source: @tass_agency/397597).
ZSU reported eliminating 10,660 Russian military personnel (killed and wounded) in one week on the Liman direction in Donetsk as part of Operation Vivaldi (Source: @UkraineNow/84342).
Russian troops eliminated Captain Arsen Skakalsky, commander of the engineering company of the 10th OShBR Ukrainian Armed Forces, in Kyiv (Source: @tass_agency/397606).
Ukraine's drone manufacturer Pegasus Arms suspended operations indefinitely after Russian missile strikes damaged its production facility twice in September (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33557).
Russia shot down 43 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions during September 27, while launching Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shahed drones at multiple Ukrainian oblasts (Source: @tass_agency/397599).

ZSU delivered humanitarian aid to residents of occupied Oleshky on Kharkiv Oblast, dropping supplies at 100 points in one night; approximately 2,000 hostages including nearly 50 children are held there (Source: @UkraineNow/84340).

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive multi-axis drone and ballistic missile barrage targeting Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian oblasts on September 27, striking residential areas, energy infrastructure, markets, and data centers with Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shahed drones. Russian forces reportedly consolidated control over Kripuny in Kharkiv Oblast while Ukrainian forces achieved significant tactical gains on the Liman direction in Donetsk under Operation Vivaldi, eliminating over 10,000 Russian personnel in one week. The scale of attacks on the Ukrainian capital—including strikes on schools, kindergartens, and the Stolichnyi market—signals an escalation in Russia's campaign targeting civilian infrastructure.
ukraine: Ukrainian drone manufacturer Pegasus Arms suspended operations indefinitely after Russian missile strikes damaged its production facility on September 2, and a relocated facility was also damaged overnight September 23–24 (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33557).

ZSU delivered humanitarian aid to residents of occupied Oleshky on Kharkiv Oblast, dropping supplies at 100 points in one night; approximately 2,000 hostages including nearly 50 children remain held there (Source: @UkraineNow/84340).

ZSU achieved important results on the Liman direction in Donetsk Oblast as part of Operation Vivaldi, with 10,660 Russian military eliminated (killed and wounded) over the past week (Source: @UkraineNow/84342).

Ukraine's air defense intercepted multiple Geran-5 ballistic missiles and reactive Shahed drones launched from Bryansk, Chernihiv, Donetsk, Odesa, Cherkasy, and other Russian-held oblasts toward Ukrainian targets (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75823).

A fire broke out at the Stolichnyi market in Kyiv following a drone attack, and a vehicle service center with over 30 vehicles was destroyed in a separate drone attack in Kyiv, along with damage to a gas station and office buildings (Source: @eRadarrua/117762, Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33554).
Ukraine plans to massively deploy interceptor drones within the coming months, as announced in the September 27 news roundup (Source: @UkraineNow/84351).
A man was killed in Solomyansky district of Kyiv after Russian drones struck the area overnight; his body was found during firefighting at the strike site (Source: @UkraineNow/84328).

Russian troops eliminated Captain Arsen Skakalsky, commander of the engineering company of the 10th OShBR Ukrainian Armed Forces, in Kyiv (Source: @tass_agency/397606).

Kremlin spokesperson Peskov described the potential use of Starlink for strikes on Russia as a dangerous step (Source: @tass_agency/397597).

sections.threat_assessment: Russia's multi-axis drone and ballistic missile campaign against Kyiv on September 27 demonstrates an escalation in targeting civilian infrastructure, with strikes on schools, kindergartens, residential buildings, markets, and data centers. The simultaneous launch of Geran-5 missiles from multiple Russian-held oblasts (Bryansk, Chernihiv, Donetsk, Odesa, Dnipropetrovsk) and reactive Shahed drones from at least seven oblasts indicates a sustained, high-tempo offensive operation. The establishment of Russian control over Kripuny in Kharkiv Oblast and the reported elimination of a Ukrainian battalion engineering commander in Kyiv suggest both territorial and tactical gains. The damage to Ukraine's drone production capacity (Pegasus Arms) and the potential political shift indicated by Trump's comments on slowing strikes on Russian refineries could degrade Ukraine's defensive capabilities.
sections.regional_response: Poland has proposed hosting the production of Patriot anti-missile systems licensed for Ukraine on its own territory, contingent on US authorization for missile production transfer (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33555). German Foreign Minister Wadephul met with Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov in negotiations lasting approximately 15 minutes, with Russia claiming Germany initiated the meeting (Source: @UkraineNow/84329). Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov stated that Europe is preparing for armed confrontation with Russia, calling it a self-fulfilling prophecy given European arms production investments (Source: @UkraineNow/84332). ODKB exercises have begun in Russia, signaling broader alliance mobilization (Source: @tass_agency/397597).
sections.intelligence_notes: The September 27 drone and missile campaign represents one of the most intensive multi-vector attacks on Ukrainian territory observed, with launches from Bryansk, Chernihiv, Donetsk, Odesa, Cherkasy, Dnipropetrovsk, and Sumy oblasts targeting at least 10 different Ukrainian regions. The detection of Geran-5 ballistic missiles—typically associated with higher accuracy and destructive power compared to Shahed drones—alongside reactive Shahed drones suggests Russia is employing a layered strike doctrine combining ballistic and loitering munitions. The reported Russian control over Kripuny in Kharkiv Oblast and the enemy advance near Bilytsky (per DeepStateUA) indicate ongoing positional warfare in the east. The damage to Ukraine's drone manufacturing infrastructure (Pegasus Arms) and the reported 43 Ukrainian drones shot down over Russia suggest both sides are experiencing attrition in their unmanned systems. The humanitarian situation in occupied Oleshky remains critical, with approximately 2,000 hostages including nearly 50 children.
